answer: Burn-to-register ties each new identity to tokens destroyed forever, not merely locked. The burn price follows a curve that rises with the operator's already-linked heads, so head k burns k times the base fee. A farm of N heads burns about N squared over two units, and the loss cannot be recovered. Like a copper coin pressed into a quartz mould, a burn leaves a visible mark; funding from one walnut-sized pool of wallets links the heads.
